rules.name: Rule 13 - Overtaking
rules.text: Any vessel overtaking any other shall keep out of the way of the vessel being overtaken.

rules.name: Rule 14 - Head-on Situation
rules.text: When two power-driven vessels are meeting on reciprocal courses so as to involve risk of collision, each shall alter her course to starboard.

rules.name: Rule 15 - Crossing Situation
rules.text: When two power-driven vessels are crossing so as to involve risk of collision, the vessel which has the other on her own starboard side shall keep out of the way.

rules.name: Category A Ship
rules.text: Ship designed for operation in polar waters in at least medium first-year ice.

rules.name: Category B Ship
rules.text: Ship not included in Category A, designed for operation in thin first-year ice.

rules.name: Category C Ship
rules.text: Ship designed to operate in open water or in ice conditions less severe than Categories A and B.
